name: Rahat Sayyed
summary: Full-stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience integrating LLMs into web applications, designing contract-driven REST APIs and architecting React front ends; cut initial load time by 11 seconds with a state management refactor and reduced development build time by ~10 minutes per cycle with a Docker pipeline redesign.

experience.title: Software Engineer
description: Led the architecture of a modular, policy-driven governance layer centralizing MCP access control and model I/O auditing across LLM agent workflows, reducing policy misconfiguration issues by ~50%.
Designed multi-policy schemas and contract-driven TypeScript APIs, reducing integration-related regressions by 70% as AI interfaces evolved.
Directed a system-wide refactor of React state management, eliminating 9+ redundant API calls and reducing initial load time by 11 seconds.
Built a unified violations ingestion pipeline across LLM, MCP and RAG flows, reducing incident investigation time by approximately 40% through centralized event tracing.
Optimized the Docker-based frontend build pipeline on AWS EC2 by restructuring dependency installation and using layer caching, reducing development build times by ~10 minutes.
Developed role-based authentication and onboarding in Next.js with tenant-level access boundaries, reducing user-reported login errors by 30% within the first month post release.
Coordinated frontend, backend, and AI teams to integrate 3+ evolving model capabilities under governance constraints, keeping policy enforcement consistent as new tools and agents launched.
